info.title: React Boilerplate API
info.description: Backend for the React boilerplate. Every response uses the shared envelope: `{ success: true, data }` on success and `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }` on failure. HTTP status describes the transport outcome; `error.code` describes the domain outcome.

revoked.description: False when there was no live session to end. Logout is idempotent either way.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the stored definition.

version.description: Optimistic lock. Send this back when writing.
Optimistic lock. Send this back when writing.

expectedVersion.description: The version last read. A mismatch answers 409.

copyFromPresetId.description: Preset to copy. Defaults to the active one.

sequence.description: Highest runtime event sequence. Unrelated to version.
Highest runtime event sequence. Unrelated to version.

expectedVersion.description: The structure version last read. A mismatch answers 409.

revision.description: The sequence this snapshot reflects. Subscribe from here.

eventId.description: Identifies this event. Clients de-duplicate on it.

entityId.description: The node or edge the event acts on.

sequence.description: Orders events within a graph. A resume continues from it.

payload.description: Either { status } for a status change or { metrics } for a metric update.

isLive.description: Derived from the stored status, never from the clock.

src.description: Manifest URL. Treated as a secret and never logged.

expiresAt.description: Short TTL. A leaked URL stops working on its own.

body.description: Empty for a deleted message; the row is retained for audit.

sentAt.description: Server clock. The client timestamp is not trusted or stored.

nextCursor.description: Null when the page reached the end.

clientMessageId.description: Client-generated id. A retry with the same id returns the stored message.

durationMs.description: Milliseconds. Omit for an indefinite mute.
